rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something inside a physical object or within an organization.

example.english: These are internal company secrets, so you can't talk about them everywhere.
example.traditional: 呢啲係公司入面嘅機密，唔可以周圍講。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 gei1 mat6 m4 ho2 ji5 zau1 wai4 gong2

rows.jyutping: san1 tai2 jap6 min6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the thing is located inside the body rather than merely inside an object or organization.

example.english: I want to know how internal organs work.
example.traditional: 我想知身體入面嘅器官點樣運作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 san1 tai2 jap6 min6 ge3 hei3 gun1 dim2 joeng2 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this for feelings or thoughts that remain inside someone's mind and are not expressed.

example.english: I have never told anyone about my internal feelings.
example.traditional: 我心入面嘅感受，一直都冇同人講。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 jap6 min6 ge3 gam2 sau6 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 tung4 jan4 gong2

rows.note: Use this in political or national contexts for affairs occurring within a country rather than abroad.

example.english: Internal affairs are more important than foreign policy.
example.traditional: 國內嘅事務比外交政策重要。
example.jyutping: gwok3 noi6 ge3 si6 mou6 bei2 ngoi6 gaau1 zing3 caak3 cung5 jiu3
